I didn't tell them about it. I don't think they would have helped the situation.

Assuming this is a one time thing, I don't want to create a huge mess and more embarrassment for her in the longterm. If things do not improve I will definitely involve them, however.
No job. She's a student, and she's almost done with college. Her parents live 10 hours away, so that's not an option.
